## Egbere (CR 6)

A pouting, child-sized creature wanders the jungle at night clutching a rolled up woven mat.  

**XP** 2,400  
CE Small undead  
**Init** +2; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +10  
**Aura** aura of gloom (30 ft., DC 17)  


**Defense**


**AC** 19, touch 14, flat-footed 16 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge, +5 natural, +1 size)  
**hp** 107 (8d8+43)  
**Fort** +6, **Ref** +4, **Will** +7  
**DR** 5/magic; Immune undead traits  


**Offense**


**Speed** 20 ft.  
**Melee** touch of death +12 touch (1d8+6 negative energy)  
**Space** 5 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  
**Special Attacks** touch of death, silent cry  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (Cl 6th; concentration +10)  


3/day—demand offering, doom, pilfering hand  

1/day—crushing despair  



**Statistics**


**Str** 22, **Dex** 14, Con—, **Int** 13, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 18  
**Base Atk** +5; **CMB** +10 (+12 steal); **CMD** 22 (24 steal)  
**Feats** Combat Expertise, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Improved Steal, Iron Will  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Climb +11, Intimidate +14, Knowledge (arcana) +8, Knowledge (religion) +8, Perception +10, Sense Motive +7, Stealth +16 (includes +4 size bonus)  
**Languages** Common, Necril  
**Sq** death wail, wealth scent  


**Special Abilities**


**Aura Of Gloom (Su)** An egbere is surrounded by an aura of despair and discontent. The first time a creature enters this aura, they must make a DC 17 Will saving throw. On a failed save, a creature can’t benefit from morale bonuses and takes a -1 penalty on Will saving throws against spells with the emotion descriptor for the next 10 minutes. Any creature that successfully saves against this aura gains immunity to it for the next 24 hours. This is a mind-affecting emotion effect. The save DC is Charisma-based.  

**Death Wail (Su)** When an egbere dies, a wail like that of millions of sad souls fills a 60 foot radius around the egbere. Any creature within the radius must make a DC 17 Fortitude save. On a failed save, a creature takes 6d6 sonic damage and gains the deafened condition (until cured). On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and is not deafened.  

**Silent Cry (Su)** As a swift action, an egbere can select one creature within 30 feet and fill its mind with an agonizing cry that only it can hear. The target must make a DC 17 Fortitude save. On a failed save, the target takes 1d8 sonic damage and is stunned 1 for 1 round. On a successful save, the target takes half damage and is not stunned 1.  

**Wealth Scent (Ex)** An egbere gains the scent ability, but only to detect objects whose value is at least 2,000 gold pieces or more. The egbere treats all magical items as overpowering scents.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** warm forests (jungle)  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** double standard
